sloka: बहुभिः हरिभिः युक्तम् आरुरोह स लक्ष्मणः ।पाण्डुरेण आतपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि ॥४-३८-१२॥
transliteration: bahubhiḥ haribhiḥ yuktam āruroha sa lakṣmaṇaḥ ।pāṇḍureṇa ātapatreṇa dhriyamāṇena mūrdhani ॥4-38-12॥

translations.english: With a pale white umbrella over his head, white yaktail fans and sounds of conches and drums, Sugriva set out receiving greetings from monkeys, rejoicing in his royal glory.
